bpb_note: BPB = (sum_CE_nats / utf8_byte_length_of_val_text) / ln(2). Val windows are non-overlapping (val_stride=context_length=256, val_overlap_pct=0.0 per dataset_stats.json) so each token is scored exactly once — BPB formula is valid. Byte boundary aligned via return_offsets_mapping (not re-sliced by token index) to avoid character-offset drift.
